headline: Administrative Assistant
summary: Administrative assistant with a year of experience in a busy provincial hospital office. I keep the director's calendar and inbox in order, handle letters and memos, and maintain a correspondence log that anyone can search. I am organised, discreet and quick with Microsoft Office.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Manage the medical director's calendar, meeting requests and inbox, and prepare the weekly schedule every Friday.
Draft, log and file incoming and outgoing letters; built a correspondence register that cut search time for old memos.
Organise the office's paper and digital files under one naming system.
Book patients' follow-up appointments with visiting specialists from Manila.

experience.title: Office Intern
bullets: Photocopied, sorted and filed permits, and answered visitor enquiries at the front desk.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
